en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> from his<sup>asws</sup> forefathers<sup>asws</sup>, from Ali<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Beware of the debts, for these are a humiliation during the day and a stress during the night, and has to be paid for in the world and in the Hereafter’.
en.sarwar: 10. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ishaq ibn Muhammad al-Nakha’iy from Muhammad ibn Jumhur from Fadalah from Musa ibn Bakr who has said the following: “I heard abu al-Hassan, Musa, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, read the following: ‘O mother, if I may become indebted (consider) that Moses son of ‘Imran would also borrow.’”
